rule: Landed hit order: petrified targets are auto-hit on every player path; knockback moves the old tile one step and always starts hit recovery (except golems); a hard hit (whole damage >= foe level + offset) starts hit recovery unless petrified; hit recovery locks the foe for its GotHit frames; a death sets nearby Fallen-type foes to Retreat for max(base - level, min) steps inside a square of radius 4; petrify is a timed mode swap that does not stack and restores the saved mode on expiry; the player flinches only above a level-based whole-damage threshold, and recovery items skip 1-3 animation frames.
keep: hard-hit threshold relative to foe level, so small pokes do nothing
stagger as a locked hit-reaction animation
petrify as an auto-hit window, not immunity
fear scatter of nearby Fallen-type foes on a death
petrified kill shatters instead of the normal death
change: no hidden shift on timers: explicit ticks in data
knockback always staggers in the donor: make it a data flag and decide with the look test
golem exemption becomes a heavy-foe flag
fear uses a square; keep the square for grid readability
look_test: Style-flag preview on the existing duel scene: small poke vs hard hit vs knockback on one foe; petrified foe (grey palette, stops acting, every swing lands); Fallen pack scatter on a death; two lock lengths and knockback with and without stagger; judge at 375 wide in a three-attacker fight.
